scope: New retained actual and the immediately relevant C/Host/driver state-identity transitions only. Same sole independent reviewer; read-only immutable Git/evidence inspection. Not a corrected-source review or native acceptance.

actual.classification: FAILED because request faults remain; not clean UNREACHED, not acceptance, not a read-only checker recovery.

source_supported_diagnosis.classification: The actual successful Host expansions plus the immediate compiled-source path support a diagnostic placement-key ACK mismatch, rather than evidence that Host expanded without held fixed state. Final correction/acceptance still needs exact frozen source and a new real control.

evidence.fact: A child relist registers a fresh child placement, declares the existing sector/child relationship, then calls the actual fixed-state reporting function.

place_declare sends LINK with sector plus child when both exist. place_fixed_state deliberately reports under the sector key while it exists, otherwise under the child key; it does not promise a separate phase-13 ACK under every alias.
A successful LINK merges the two placements into one canonical record and merges their fixed state, refusing inconsistent existing states. It does not create state from a candidate question.
The real expansion joins the child to the current city record and requires FixedHold::Held on the child canonical record. Missing/withdrawn/wrong-parent state is refused before geometry lookup.

Expanded is returned only after city_expansion provides the held building state and the real model-store expansion succeeds. Thus six actual answered expansions are evidence that the Host had required canonical fixed state, not proof that the driver had tracked its ACK correctly.
The driver records fixed ACKs only at the literal report key and tests held[the new child key] for an expansion.
Existing LINK tracking handles a CITY sector continuation of its list record; it does not propagate or resolve a building sector/child fixed-ACK relationship.

source_supported_diagnosis.inference_limit: The aggregate actual row is not a new raw per-event ACK transcript. Exact real C order, Host state requirements and the returned results support the diagnosis; do not claim every raw ACK was independently recorded in that row or promote successful geometry equality alone to validity.

minimum_correction_constraints: Resolve held-state evidence through only the exact CURRENT successful LINK relationship and a previously validated positive fixed-state ACK on that same record. Do not accept an arbitrary held key, matching type/count, parent CITY state, name or geometrically equal result as building-state evidence.

Validate the complete current request and same-key LINK ACK before binding aliases or granting eligibility. A refused/raised/malformed/wrong-record/wrong-name/p-bearing ACK and unrelated live record must not create the relationship or credit an expansion.

Preserve both real orders: initial child-before-sector creation and relisted child when a live sector placement survives. The real C path declares the link and can report state only under the sector key; tests must reproduce this without inventing an extra child-key fixed report.

A single-placement removal must invalidate the ended alias while preserving evidence reachable through its remaining legitimate placement. Clear, physical last-placement retirement, failed links and unrelated key reuse must not leave a usable stale ACK alias. Do not confuse the separate retained CITY-list anchor with a building record.

Keep strict missing/withdrawn/wrong-held-record/wrong-alias errors. Resolve any existing by_key words or candidate/intervention joins only through the proven current record relation; never learn physical state from the expansion result or candidate mirror.

Keep fault precedence above UNREACHED/completed and preserve no-intervention/no-credit on malformed relations. Do not suppress the six existing faults, normalize old output, credit a later unrelated ACK, or fabricate fixture-only production reports.

Keep physical report and ACK event counts honest: alias recognition is not an extra phase-13 report. If an observer-lifetime/held-key count changes its declared meaning, qualify that diagnostic delta explicitly instead of claiming all old fields unchanged.

If immutable source inspection instead uncovers an actual missing production state write for a supported path, fix that actual shared writer. The source-backed path above does not justify adding redundant physical reports solely to satisfy this literal-key observer.
focused_controls: Coherent real-provider relist sequence first: an existing positively ACKed sector state, fresh child insertion, exact successful LINK, sector-key state ACK as the actual C emits, then expansion naming the fresh child. Include original child-before-sector order.

Single-fault controls for no state ACK, wrong live record/alias, wrong or malformed LINK ACK, failed link and stale ended alias/clear. They must fail with zero eligibility/intervention credit and must not be misclassified as clean UNREACHED.

Preserve constructor/retention/release/strict-report/mirror-negative source closures and public phase5/8 named-Removed bridge fix; do not bypass the real Core fixture or replace it with provider-only replay.

A verified diagnostic-Lua/test-only change can be separately bound to sealed runtime354ab; any production delta needs its own new production validation.
